notes.title: Notification of bug fixes
notes.content:
Fixes have been carried out for crashes occurring on the below hardware. Please be sure to install the update dated August 26th 2024.
Hardware for which fixes have been confirmed:
• RX 7000-series hardware, including AMD Radeon RX 7800 XT and AMD Radeon RX 7900 XT
• ASUS ROG Ally RC71L-Z1E512

Affected titles:
◆ The below titles included in KINGDOM HEARTS -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX-
　- KINGDOM HEARTS FINAL MIX
    - KINGDOM HEARTS Re:Chain of Memories
　- KINGDOM HEARTS II FINAL MIX
　- KINGDOM HEARTS Birth by Sleep FINAL MIX

◆ The below titles included in KINGDOM HEARTS HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue
　- KINGDOM HEARTS Dream Drop Distance HD
　- KINGDOM HEARTS χ Back Cover

We apologise to any players who have been affected by this.
If you should find that crashes continue to occur even after installing the update, please contact the SQUARE ENIX support centre.
• KINGDOM HEARTS -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX-
　https://support.na.square-enix.com/main.php?la=1&id=15941
• KINGDOM HEARTS HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue
　https://support.na.square-enix.com/main.php?la=1&id=15501

notes.title: Add KINGDOM HEARTS HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue to your wishlist now!
notes.content:
KINGDOM HEARTS HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue is a special bundle that includes three works connected to the story of KINGDOM HEARTS III.

With the release on Steam, environmental textures in KINGDOM HEARTS Dream Drop Distance HD have been upgraded to an even higher quality!
In this HD Remaster, the worlds of KINGDOM HEARTS are even more beautiful than before.



 KINGDOM HEARTS Dream Drop Distance HD
An HD remaster of KINGDOM HEARTS 3D Dream Drop Distance, originally released in 2012. In preparation for coming threats, series protagonists Sora and Riku decide to take the Mark of Mastery exam to be recognised as Keyblade Masters. To pass the exam, they will need to unlock seven Sleeping Keyholes, gain new powers, and return safely...
 
 KINGDOM HEARTS χ Back Cover (cinematic content)
An HD movie that tells the mysterious story of the Foretellers, taking place alongside the stories of the browser and mobile instalments in the series, KINGDOM HEARTS χ[chi] and KINGDOM HEARTS Unchained χ[chi]. The short story has important implications for the Kingdom Hearts series.
 
 KINGDOM HEARTS 0.2 Birth by Sleep -A fragmentary passage-
A short episode that takes place after the events of KINGDOM HEARTS Birth by Sleep, originally released in 2011, and connecting to the story of KINGDOM HEARTS III. In this episode, you will play as Aqua, one of the series protagonists.
